answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 49793 Country: India Title: Ghusul Question: Will you, please, let me know whether it is permissible to repeat intercourse with wife without ablution or taking bath for the first intercourse? And what to do if one wants to go for such intercourse? Answer ID: 49793 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 149/108/L=02/1435) After having sex with wife, it is lawful to have a second intercourse even without wudhu or ghusl, but it is better to do ghusl, or do wudhu or at least wash the private parts. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
